period_note: Half-Yearly (Jan-Jun) filing used as the Q2 data point per project convention. Standalone (solo) basis, from the bank's own 'Balance Sheet'/'Profit and Loss Account' (distinct from the 'Consolidated Balance Sheet'/'Consolidated Profit and Loss Account' shown alongside them in the same filing). Income-statement items use the 'Cumulative Jan to June 2013' column; the filing also separately discloses a discrete 'Quarter ended Apr to Jun 2013' column (interest income 4,390,041,727; PAT 369,649,587; EPS 0.83) not recorded here. Balance sheet identity reconciles exactly (164,050,392,666 = 152,972,826,746 + 11,077,565,920). Every P&L subtotal reconciles exactly. Preference share capital (Tk 350m as of 2011_Q2/2012_Q2) has been fully redeemed by this date — both the June-2013 and December-2012 comparative columns show nil, so no preference_share_capital line item is recorded this quarter. Consolidated comparison: consolidated PAT cumulative 950,779,643 vs solo 877,924,055; consolidated EPS cumulative 2.19 vs solo 1.98. RESTATEMENT NOTE (data-quality check): the subsequent 2014 H1 filing's comparative 'Cumulative Jan to Jun 2013' column shows this same period's PAT as 877,924,056 (a 1-taka rounding difference from the 877,924,055 reported here — not substantive) but restates EPS down to 1.80 (vs. 1.98 reported here), consistent with a retrospective weighted-average-share (BAS 33) effect from the further capital increase between Jun-2013 (paid-up capital 4,433,045,760) and Jun-2014 (7,092,873,210). Per project convention, this file retains the originally-reported EPS of 1.98. Matches the basis of this bank's own 2012-2016 Q4/annual series (solo).
